_doc: Review MEDIUM-2 of PR #4342. The success path prints that the `.conflict.local.txt` backup is 'excluded from BOTH sync predicates'. That is a claim about two named functions in core, so the axis (Q6) imports the PRODUCTION predicates and asserts both, with a canary that they are not simply false for everything. This spec is what locks it: removing `.conflict.` from ONE predicate must redden Q6. Without it the claim was an identically-green toMatch mirroring the source string — the word BOTH was a counter with no `if` behind it (self-satisfying-metric-weak-verifier §A38). ⛤ cli suites resolve @kitelev/exocortex-core from core SRC (jest moduleNameMapper), so a core mutant reaches the cli axis with no build step. Set `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (committed with a placeholder, §A76). ⛤ The harness resolves the cli package RELATIVE TO {subject} so the driver's copied tree is what runs; a hardcoded absolute path made the driver report 'подмена предмета НЕ доезжает', which is the right refusal — the delivery of the mutation was unverifiable. The subject sits five levels below the tree (packages/core/src/services/sync), not four as for a cli command.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/sync/syncTypes.ts
